result_text:
Contributor lists and the recent-commits bar chart now include every contributor, whatever `contributorsListLimit` says. The `reports` module compiles offline. I didn't write a test for this, and the existing test run found no landscape tests to exercise it.

Changes, both in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/landscape/statichtml/`:

- **`LandscapeContributorsReport.java`**: `saveContributorsTable` no longer applies `.limit(...)` to the contributor table, so the bots, teams, "All" and "Recent" tables all list everyone. I also removed the "The list is limited to N items (out of M)." note. The sort order is unchanged.
- **`LandscapeReportContributorsTab.java`**: the recently-active bar chart iterates over all `recentContributors` instead of the first N.

`contributorsListLimit` stays in `LandscapeConfiguration` as a field with its getter and setter. Nothing reads it any more, so it is now a dead setting. Say if you'd rather I remove it.

Nothing is committed.
